verses.text: The LORD rules! He is dressed in majesty. The LORD is dressed in strength. The world is firmly in place. It cannot be moved.
Your throne was set up long ago. You have always existed.
The seas have risen up, LORD. The seas have raised their voice. The seas lift up their pounding waves.
The LORD on high is mightier than the roar of many waters, mightier than the crashing waves of the sea.
Your laws stand firm. Holiness fills your house, LORD, forever.
